---
title: "Corporate PAC giving by candidate HRC score"
---

{{< include _notice.qmd >}}

How much direct campaign money did each corporate PAC give to candidates, grouped by the
candidate's [Human Rights Campaign](https://www.hrc.org/) Congressional Scorecard score? Pick a PAC, cycle
and office below. Labels on the bars show dollars and the number of candidates.

::: {.note-box}
**Direct contributions only.** These are contributions made straight to candidate committees.
Money routed through leadership PACs or party committees is not included. Scores are the
**118th Congress (2023-24)** record, applied to donations from both the 2024 and 2026 cycles.
*No score* means the candidate has no HRC score (for example, challengers or new members).
:::

```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
from pals_site import BINS, CYCLE_LABELS, NOTICE, OFFICE_OPTIONS, bin_color, load

data = load()
summary = data["summary"].copy()
summary["cycle_label"] = summary["cycle"].map(CYCLE_LABELS)
summary["bin_order"] = summary["score_bin"].map({b: i for i, b in enumerate(BINS)})
pacs = sorted(summary["pac"].unique())
alt.data_transformers.disable_max_rows()

pac_p = alt.param(name="pac", value="Google", bind=alt.binding_select(options=pacs, name="PAC: "))
cycle_p = alt.param(name="cycle", value="All", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["All", "2024", "2026"], labels=["Both cycles", "2024", "2026"], name="Cycle: "))
office_p = alt.param(name="office", value="All", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=OFFICE_OPTIONS, labels=["All", "House", "Senate"], name="Office: "))
measure_p = alt.param(name="measure", value="Dollars", bind=alt.binding_radio(
    options=["Dollars", "Share of PAC total", "Candidates"], name="Show: "))

# PAC/cycle/office combos with nothing to show (e.g. Anthropic) get an explicit message
totals = summary.groupby(["pac", "cycle", "office"], as_index=False, observed=True)["dollars"].sum()
empty = totals[totals["dollars"] == 0].assign(
    msg="No direct candidate contributions recorded for this PAC, period and office")

VALUE = ("measure == 'Dollars' ? datum.dollars : measure == 'Share of PAC total' ? datum.share : datum.candidates")
AXIS = ("measure == 'Dollars' ? '$' + format(datum.value, ',.0f') : measure == 'Candidates' ? "
        "format(datum.value, ',d') : format(datum.value, '.0%')")
FILTER = "datum.pac == pac && datum.cycle == cycle && datum.office == office"
TOOLTIP = [
    alt.Tooltip("pac:N", title="PAC"),
    alt.Tooltip("cycle_label:N", title="Cycle"),
    alt.Tooltip("office:N", title="Office"),
    alt.Tooltip("score_bin:N", title="HRC score bin"),
    alt.Tooltip("dollars:Q", title="Dollars", format="$,.0f"),
    alt.Tooltip("candidates:Q", title="Candidates"),
    alt.Tooltip("share:Q", title="Share of PAC total", format=".1%"),
]

base = alt.Chart(summary).transform_filter(FILTER).transform_calculate(value=VALUE)
x_bin = alt.X("score_bin:O", sort=BINS, title="Candidate HRC score (118th Congress)", axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=0))
bars = base.mark_bar().encode(
    x=x_bin,
    y=alt.Y("value:Q", title="Direct contributions", axis=alt.Axis(labelExpr=AXIS)),
    color=bin_color(legend=False),
    tooltip=TOOLTIP,
)
labels = (
    base.transform_calculate(
        l1="datum.dollars == 0 && datum.candidates == 0 ? '' : '$' + format(datum.dollars, '.3~s')",
        l2="datum.candidates == 0 ? '' : datum.candidates + (datum.candidates == 1 ? ' cand.' : ' cands.')",
    )
    .mark_text(baseline="bottom", dy=-16, fontSize=11, color="#222")
    .encode(x=x_bin, y="value:Q", text="l1:N")
)
labels2 = labels.mark_text(baseline="bottom", dy=-4, fontSize=11, color="#780000", fontWeight="bold").encode(text="l2:N")
message = (
    alt.Chart(empty).transform_filter(FILTER)
    .mark_text(fontSize=15, color="#780000", fontWeight="bold")
    .encode(text="msg:N", x=alt.value(300), y=alt.value(110))
)
title = alt.TitleParams("Direct contributions by candidate HRC score bin", subtitle=NOTICE,
                        subtitleColor="#444", fontSize=15, anchor="start")
main = (bars + labels + labels2 + message).properties(width="container", height=320, title=title)

# Same PAC/cycle, split by office
by_office = summary[summary["office"] != "All"]
off_base = (alt.Chart(by_office)
            .transform_filter("datum.pac == pac && datum.cycle == cycle")
            .transform_calculate(value=VALUE))
off_bars = off_base.mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X("office:O", sort=["House", "Senate"], title="Office", axis=alt.Axis(labelAngle=0)),
    y=alt.Y("value:Q", title="Direct contributions", stack="zero", axis=alt.Axis(labelExpr=AXIS)),
    color=bin_color(),
    order=alt.Order("bin_order:Q"),
    tooltip=TOOLTIP,
)
off_tot = (by_office.groupby(["pac", "cycle", "office"], as_index=False, observed=True)
           .agg(dollars=("dollars", "sum"), candidates=("candidates", "sum")))
off_tot["share"] = (off_tot["dollars"] != 0).astype(float)
off_text = (
    alt.Chart(off_tot).transform_filter("datum.pac == pac && datum.cycle == cycle")
    .transform_calculate(
        value=VALUE,
        label="'$' + format(datum.dollars, '.3~s') + ' · ' + datum.candidates + ' cand.'")
    .mark_text(baseline="bottom", dy=-4, fontSize=11, color="#222")
    .encode(x=alt.X("office:O", sort=["House", "Senate"]), y="value:Q", text="label:N")
)
off_title = alt.TitleParams("Same PAC by office (House, Senate)", subtitle=NOTICE,
                            subtitleColor="#444", fontSize=15, anchor="start")
by_off_chart = (off_bars + off_text).properties(width="container", height=260, title=off_title)

chart = (alt.vconcat(main, by_off_chart, spacing=30)
         .add_params(pac_p, cycle_p, office_p, measure_p)
         .resolve_scale(color="independent"))

# Vega-Lite only sizes a single view to its container; for a stacked pair, set it on the top-level spec.
from IPython.display import display
spec = chart.to_dict()
spec.update(width="container", autosize={"type": "fit-x", "contains": "padding"})
display(alt.renderers.get()(spec), raw=True)
```

## The numbers behind the chart

All offices, both cycles, net of refunds and voided contributions. Each cell is dollars with the number of
candidates in parentheses (a candidate is counted once per PAC).

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML
s = summary[(summary["cycle"] == "All") & (summary["office"] == "All")]
cell = s.assign(txt=s.apply(lambda r: f"${r.dollars:,.0f} ({r.candidates:,})", axis=1))
piv = cell.pivot(index="score_bin", columns="pac", values="txt").reindex(BINS)
tot = s.groupby("pac", observed=True).agg(d=("dollars", "sum"), c=("candidates", "sum"))
piv.loc["Total"] = tot.apply(lambda r: f"${r.d:,.0f} ({int(r.c):,})", axis=1)
html = piv.to_html(classes="table table-sm", border=0)
HTML(f'<div class="table-responsive">{html}</div><p><small>{NOTICE}</small></p>')
```
